summary: Extended support bundle projection with read-only ecosystem registry, lockfile, active set, replay, trust and revocation state.

Revoked/degraded active artifact state is visible through revocation_status.
Projection excludes raw secrets and private key paths while keeping private_key_paths_included=false.
